title: TradeAgreement
description:
A seller issued sales contract, also called a sale confirmation.
The buyer issued mirror of this document is {@link IPurchaseOrder}; the
seller assigns the contract number, so `sellerReference` is mandatory here.
Incoterms, payment terms, shipment period, destination and governing terms
are all inherited. See docs/model-guide.md §2.3.

sellerReference.description: A seller reference, expressed as text, for this header trade agreement.

issueDateTime.description: The date the document was issued.

buyerParty.description: The buyer party for this sales contract.

sellerParty.description: The seller party for this sales contract.

includedSupplyChainTradeLineItem.description:
A contracted lot. Optional: a single lot contract states quantity,
quality and price at header level and has no line breakdown.

includedNote.description:
Contractual prose with no typed UN/CEFACT slot, discriminated by
`subject`. See {@link IPurchaseOrder.includedNote}.

TradeParty.title: TradeParty
TradeParty.description:
A party taking a role in a trade document, such as the buyer or the seller.
Only the name is mandatory: sample documents identify counterparties by name
alone, so requiring an address would reject a real document. The address,
role codes, identifiers and contacts are all inherited and optional.

name.description: A name, expressed as text, for this trade party.
